**СЛАЙД 1**

Save on your vacation with Tumodo  
**СЛАЙД 2**

**A new feature for personal bookings**

Employees can now switch to **Vacation mode** in their Tumodo account.

We introduced this option so that not only businesses, but also the people behind them, can save on flights and accommodation when planning a vacation.

**With Vacation mode, employees can:**

* book flights and accommodation for personal travel,

* pay for services with their own card,

* use not only individual bonuses, but also corporate rates.

**СЛАЙД 3**

**Easy flight booking**

* Access to 500+ airlines

* Flexible filters for flight class, price, layovers and more

* Flight selections you can share with travellers

* The ability to save flights to favourites

* Booking for multiple passengers in one go

*\+ скриншот страницы оформления услуги*

**СЛАЙД 4**

**Comfortable accommodation**

* Access to 3.5M+ accommodation options,

* prices lower than on other platforms,

* the ability to choose the number of rooms,

* flexible filters by any criteria, including refundable and non-refundable rates and instant confirmation,

* comments for friends and family travelling with you.

*\+ скриншот страницы поиска проживания*

**СЛАЙД 5**

**Comfortable accommodation**

+ *скриншот оформления услуги в разделе жилья*

**СЛАЙД 6**

How to book a vacation in Tumodo  
**СЛАЙД 7**

**How to switch to Vacation mode**

1. Log in to your Tumodo account

*\+ скриншот главной страницы личного кабинета*

**СЛАЙД 8**

2\. To switch to Vacation mode, select the palm tree icon on your dashboard

*\+ скриншот рабочего стола с переключением в Vacation mode*

![][image1]

**СЛАЙД 9**

**How to add travellers**

1. When you switch to **Vacation mode**, a new **Travellers** section appears in the upper right corner.  
   Go to this section \[1\] and click **Create** \[2\] to add family members or friends to your trip.

*\+ скриншот раздела «Путешественники»*

**СЛАЙД 10**

2\. In the pop-up window, fill in the fields marked with a red asterisk\*

Please make sure the traveller’s name details match the travel document you will use for this trip.

![][image2]

\+ *скриншот формы добавления путешественника*

**СЛАЙД 11**

3\. To book services, add the traveller’s document details by clicking **Add**

Enter the details of the travel document required for your trip.

If needed, you can add an alternative document in the **Other document** field.

*\+ скриншот формы добавления документов путешественника*

![][image3]

**СЛАЙД 12** 

4\. Optionally, you can add:

* email address,

* phone number,

* mile card details.  
  ![][image4]

Tickets and accommodation vouchers will be sent to the provided email address.

*\+ скриншот формы контактов и документов путешественника*

**СЛАЙД 13**

5\. Details of added travellers are automatically saved in your Tumodo account. If you want to remove them later, simply enable the **Block** option.

*\+ скриншот редактирования профиля путешественника*

**![][image5]**

**СЛАЙД 14**

**How to add a bank card**

1. Create a trip for your vacation

2. In the pop-up window, open the **Payment method** field and select **Add card\[1\]**

3. Fill in the required details and confirm data processing by clicking **Add card**\[2\]

*\+ 2 скриншота экрана добавления банковской карты*

*![][image6]*

*![][image7]*

**СЛАЙД 15**

To confirm your bank card details, an SMS code will be sent to the phone number linked to your card. Enter the code to complete a verification check.

A small symbolic amount may be temporarily charged to your card and refunded immediately — there’s no need to worry.

If the code does not arrive within the specified time, you can request a new one by clicking **Code not arriving?**

\+*скриншот подтверждения карты через код*

**СЛАЙД 16**

**How to remove saved bank card details**

If you want to remove a bank card after booking your trip, open the edit mode and click the trash icon next to the card.

*\+ скриншоты экрана редактирования профиля с платёжными картами*

*![][image8]*

**СЛАЙД 17**

**How to search for flights for your vacation**

1. Click the Flights icon \[1\]

2. Enter your destination and travel dates, then select travellers

3. If needed, choose a flight class

4. Click Search \[2\]

5. Use filters to refine your search

6. Save flights to favourites or add them to a selection if needed

*\+ скриншот страницы поиска авиабилетов*

*![][image9]*

![][image10]

**СЛАЙД 18**

**How to book flights for your vacation**

1. Choose a flight and click on the price to continue

2. In the panel that opens on the right, select a fare, review traveller details and click **Book**

*\+ скриншот экрана выбора тарифа и бронирования авиабилетов*

*![][image11]*

**СЛАЙД 19**

**How to search for accommodation for your vacation**

1. Click the **Accommodation** icon

2. Enter your destination and travel dates, then select travellers

3. Choose the number of rooms if needed

4. Click **Search**

5. Use filters to refine your search

6. Save interesting hotels to favourites if needed

*\+ скриншот страницы поиска проживания*  
*![][image12]*

![][image13]

**СЛАЙД 20**

**How to book accommodation for your vacation**

1. Click on the hotel card you’ve selected  
   In the panel that opens on the right, you’ll find all the key information about the hotel:  
   * photos,

   * location on the map,

   * hotel description,

   * room options,

   * hotel services,

   * important details (we recommend reviewing them before booking),

   * guest reviews.  
   *   
     ![][image14]

*\+ скриншот карточки отеля с деталями*

**СЛАЙД 21**

2\. Select a room and click **Book**

3\. If needed, add a comment for the people travelling with you

4\. Then confirm the booking

*\+ скриншот экрана бронирования номера и подтверждения проживания*

*![][image15]*

**СЛАЙД 22**

**How to search for car transfers for your vacation**

1. Click the **Transfers** icon

2. Enter the pick-up and drop-off locations, then select travellers

3. Click **Search**

*\+ скриншот страницы поиска трансфера*

*![][image16]*

**СЛАЙД 23**

**How to book a car transfer for your vacation**

1. Select a suitable option from the list and click on the price

2. In the panel that opens on the right, fill in the required details (a phone number is required for contact)

3. Click **Book**

*\+ скриншот экрана бронирования трансфера*

*![][image17]*

*![][image18]*

**СЛАЙД 24**

**How to complete your vacation booking**

1. Once all services are booked, they move to the **Reserved** status. This status allows you to either confirm or cancel services before payment. To complete your vacation booking, open your trip and click **Reserve** under each service.

As soon as your trip is confirmed, a **Travel Plan** will appear in your Tumodo account — a handy overview of all your bookings.

*\+ скриншот страницы поездки с услугами в статусе Reserved и кнопкой Confirm*

*![][image19]*

**СЛАЙД 25**

**Additional information**

Watch the video guide

If you have any questions about **Vacation mode**, please contact your service manager. We’ll be happy to help you plan and book your vacation with Tumodo.
